description: This Java class 'EncryptionImpl' provides utility methods for encrypting and decrypting strings using AES encryption with CBC mode and PKCS5 padding. It manages secret keys, initialization vectors, and hex encoding of encrypted data.

classes.name: EncryptionImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing encryption and decryption methods using AES with CBC mode and PKCS5 padding.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input string using AES encryption with a secret key, IV, and returns the hex-encoded encrypted string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input hex-encoded string using AES decryption with the secret key and IV.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts byte array to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to its corresponding byte array.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the secret key used for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: setSecretKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key to be used for encryption and decryption.
